nodes.label: Web manifest + apple-touch-icon for Home Screen install
nodes.rationale: iOS ignores the manifest's icons array for the Home Screen icon and reads only <link rel=apple-touch-icon>, so a 180×180 PNG is required regardless of the manifest's Android-oriented icon set.

nodes.label: Rolling Auth0 session (30d inactivity / 90d absolute)
nodes.rationale: The SDK's 1-day inactivity default re-prompts login on every home-screen relaunch after a day away, which feels broken for an installed 'app', so the session was made rolling with a much longer inactivity/absolute window.
